accounting.rationale: Forms a per-scope block sequence in object-list order, closes it under eligible equivalence association and forbids extension before its first unit.
The construction is for each block in one scoping unit.
Step1 uses every listed object's storage sequence.
The resulting sequence contains those storage units.
Closure includes all storage units of those sequences.
New units may be added only beyond the last unit.
Objects associated with a COMMON entity count as in that block.
Bounds the contributors to this scope's construction. It does not append text from other scopes or automatically count a source graph.
COMMON statements are one contributor kind.
EQUIVALENCE statements are the other contributor kind.
Only statements actually in this scoping unit contribute.
Their result is the sequence formed in that same scope.

requirements.title: The per-scope sequence preserves order and includes the equivalence tail
requirements.definition: The block sequence concatenates its listed objects' storage sequences in appearance order and includes all units brought in by eligible equivalence association. This is a language storage-sequence construction, not an ABI layout measurement. Other scopes supply matching views, not extra local lists.

pending.list-order-finite-parent: PENDING a separately adjudicated finite relation to one complete S8.10.2.1-001 ordered-list parent once it actually exists. Bind every writer/reader declaration and occurrence, all inputs, current source/requirement/review fingerprints and literal tuple oracle. No case is assumed to exist, no duplicate execution is created and no link is implemented or credited by this pending plan.
pending.array-element-order: PENDING complete driver, writer and reader with matching saved named COMMON. Writer has INTEGER a(-1:0,2:3); reader has INTEGER flat(4). Seed all four elements and assign a(-1,2)=11, a(0,2)=22, a(-1,3)=33, a(0,3)=44. Require flat=[11,22,33,44] literally. Wrong row-order and lower-bound assumptions must fail the whole parent.
pending.direct-equivalence-tail: PENDING complete writer with INTEGER first, extension(3), COMMON /packet/ first and EQUIVALENCE(first,extension(1)); complete reader declares a size3 INTEGER COMMON view. Both save the same named block. Seed extension, assign11,22,33, then require those three literal positions. Include the extension in both scopes' block-size adjudication.
pending.transitive-equivalence-tail: PENDING complete writer declares INTEGER first, middle(2), tail(3), COMMON /packet/ first, and EQUIVALENCE(first,middle(1)),(middle(2),tail(1)). The resulting sequence has four numeric units, not one, two or three. Seed first and all tail positions, set first=11 and tail=[22,33,44], and compare a complete saved reader view of size4 to those literals. Retain all C8110-C8120, 8.10.1.5 and8.10.3 constraints; no TARGET, BIND, default initialization or illegal backward extension is introduced.

requirements.oracle: Source-derived storage-unit closure, then actual same-type defined-value observations in the complete future programs. Every future effect requires a complete driver and all declaring/defining procedures, actual successful compile/link/run traces in the required f2023 configuration, independent literal observations and executed-call/completion checks. For named COMMON initial families, put consistent SAVE /block/ in every nonexempt declaring procedure and match the complete storage sequences; avoid relying on an accidentally active scope or implicit SAVE. Seed every observed storage unit with a known sentinel before the operation under test, so omitted-write sensitivity never reads undefined data. Keep actual arguments distinct from COMMON storage to avoid dummy-aliasing violations. Wrong-order/value/omission/omitted-call mutations must fail the whole counted parent, not a detached expression. No such program or mutation has been implemented here.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Neither membership definitions nor a complete static graph are counted as runtime effects. Zero-sized sequences contribute no payload; addresses, STORAGE_SIZE-to-byte guesses and same-processor TRANSFER are not substitutes. All proposed evidence remains PENDING. No case, direct/linked facet, SourceUse relationship, inventory renewal, source approval, baseline change or universal conformance credit is created. Each reference/target/configuration is separate; f2018 success cannot corroborate an f2023 expectation. Numerical-kind, real/BOZ/IEEE, coarray and companion/CFI-header gates remain with their actual owners. Missing or unsupported prerequisite evidence cannot be treated as success.

review_rationale: Independent original-source review925b4227 and all4pending plans in doc/source_audits/batch_084.json. Local COMMON lists concatenate actual language storage sequences and eligible EQUIVALENCE closure includes the full tail. The separate tail-only prohibition is accounted under S8.10.3-003, not duplicated. Table9.1 was visually checked for lower-bound-dependent array order. Complete direct/transitive tail programs must match full size and source/definedness/SAVE conditions across scopes. Membership and per-scope construction definitions do not create empty effects; proposed reuse remains unimplemented.
